response.sql: WITH region_counts AS (SELECT d.A3, COUNT(c.client_id) as client_count FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), region_shares AS (SELECT client_count, CAST(client_count AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(client_count) FROM region_counts) as share FROM region_counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM region_shares) SELECT SUM(rs.client_count) as total_clients, AVG(rs.share) as average_share, AVG(rs.share) - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share) as avg_distance_above_average FROM region_shares rs CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE rs.share > a.avg_share
